negative_evidence: The latent transition structure is experiment-defined; the fitted HMM is not evidence that this transition structure was learned neurally by the same operator.
The paper does not model initial acquisition of the overall world-model structure; changes in gamma characterize improved use of past evidence.
Gamma and sigma can be moderately anticorrelated, limiting unique mechanistic interpretation.
A more complex asymmetric B variant helps some subjects but is not adopted as the average central model.
unresolved_issues: Initial learning of the task transition structure is outside the modeled mechanism.
Gamma/sigma anticorrelation limits unique mechanistic interpretation.
